sloka: तेषां तु युध्यमानानां साग्रः संवत्सरो गतः ।न चान्यतरयोस्तत्र विजयो वा क्षयो ऽपि वा ।। ७.२३.९ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tu yudhyamānānāṁ sāgraḥ saṁvatsaro gataḥ ।na cānyatarayostatra vijayo vā kṣayo 'pi vā ।। 7.23.9 ॥

translations.english: As they continued to fight, more than a year passed, yet neither side achieved victory nor suffered complete destruction.
